changeLog.actionRequired: Print official FSSAI emblem with 14-digit license number (Lic. No. 1XXXXXXXXXXXXX) on back panel.
Incorporate standard green filled circle of minimum 3mm diameter inside a green square outline.
Include full registered office address, factory unit number, and 6-digit postal PIN code.
Reposition thermal batch print away from package sealing crimp to ensure 100% legibility.
